title: The Beautiful World
full_text: Our world is full of wonderful places. There are high mountains and deep oceans. There are hot deserts and cold poles. There are green forests and yellow plains. Many animals live in these places. Elephants walk in the savanna. Penguins swim in the icy water. Whales sing in the deep sea. People from different cultures live together. We all share this one planet. We should protect it with love. Every creature has its own role in nature. We need to live in harmony. The future depends on our actions today.
